content: Session 2026-08-17: Investigated dummy packages wrapper vs symlink approach. Wrapper scripts broke efi-mkuki because rg doesn't support POSIX BRE (\+). Reverted to symlink approach. GNU grep removed (BusyBox grep used instead). Aliases removed from misc.go. Added Bin field to DummyPackageRule for binary name override. 480 packages installed, ~13% memory-safe. Harness 27/27 pass.
Ripgrep NOT a drop-in for grep: rg doesn't support POSIX BRE (\+). efi-mkuki uses grep with \+ for kernel version validation. GNU grep removed, BusyBox grep used instead.

Session 2026-08-18: Swapfile investigation. Added nodatacow mount option to NoCoW subvolumes. Removed autodefrag from @swap. chattr +C fails on btrfs (Invalid argument). Swapfile still fails at boot with swapon Invalid argument. Harness 27/27 pass. Commit 9271d97.
chattr +C fails on btrfs with Invalid argument. btrfs already sets NoCoW automatically (lsattr shows m flag). nodatacow mount option is the correct way to disable CoW on btrfs subvolumes.

btrfs swapfile swapon fails with Invalid argument on kernel 6.18. nodatacow mount option set, compression disabled, autodefrag removed. Needs investigation: kernel 6.18 may have changed btrfs swapfile requirements.

Session 2026-08-18 PM: btrfs swapfile investigation. btrfs filesystem mkswapfile fails with cannot set NOCOW flag. compress=zstd:3 inherited from root conflicts with NODATACOW. Added compress=none to @swap mount. Still fails. Harness 27/27 pass. Commit 04022e4.

CRITICAL: btrfs swapfile swapon fails on kernel 6.18. btrfs filesystem mkswapfile cannot set NOCOW flag when compression is active. compress=zstd:3 inherited from root subvolume. compress=none added to mount options but still fails. Needs deep investigation: btrfs-progs version, kernel 6.18 changes, or alternative approach.

Today: implemented log_errors + services_status harness checks (non-regression guard + active services verification, QEMU-only exclusions smartd/fsck/udev-settle), full golangci-lint cleanup harness+src (commit 6b42ff3, 5d036e7), harness run 30/30 PASS after refactor, apk-new verified (swap sed survives upgrades). Next: full run 31/31, real hardware NVMe.
services_status check excludes QEMU-only services: smartd (no SMART hardware, crashed), fsck (fsck.vfat not installed), udev-settle (one-shot). log_errors whitelist extended with their log lines.

Today: implemented niri desktop environment (greetd + regreet + niri + wayvnc + DMS). nixPackages field in internalRules (auto-enables Nix), chrootPhase/desktops/niri.go configs, OpenRC dms service. Nix: --option sandbox false chroot-only (trusted-users), TMPDIR on @nix-var-nix-build subvolume, registry pinned to nixos-26.05 stable, NIXPKGS_ALLOW_* env vars (nix.conf allow-* not supported). Alpine: wayland-libs-server, greeter in greetd group, elogind seat provider, no render group, no turnstile (edge only). sudoers @includedir enabled. Harness 37/37 PASS. Next: real hardware NVMe, kde test.

nix.conf allow-unfree/allow-insecure NOT recognized by Alpine nix build (unknown setting warnings) — NIXPKGS_ALLOW_* env vars in profile.d/fish/bash are the permanent mechanism. TMPDIR not a nix.conf option — stays in profile.d.

Swap refactor: enableSwapfile toggle (default true, @swap subvolume always created), zswap split into SetupZswapServer (btrfsStandardServer only, always, aggressive) + SetupZswap (toggleable, conservative, guards: skip server, skip no-swap-in-fstab). dmcrypt swap moved to disk layout (hostPhase, no chroot commands). btrfsStandardServer LUKS swap root cause: keyfile+conf.d written before root fs mounted at /mnt (files lost) — fixed: keyfile at /tmp for luksAddKey, installed into chroot after subvol mounts (step 8a). fstab swap uses /dev/mapper/swap-* (busybox swapon -a can't resolve LABEL). swap_status check now truthful. swap service conditional (btrfsStandard only if enableSwapfile, Server always). nix subvolumes always present in all 3 layouts (27 identical). Verified 32/32 PASS btrfsStandardServer. Next: btrfsRaid0 (zram vs partition swap).

busybox swapon -a does NOT resolve LABEL=/UUID= in fstab (reads device field as literal path) — use /dev/mapper/swap-* for dmcrypt swap. dmcrypt keyfile+conf.d must be written AFTER the btrfs root is mounted at /mnt (hostPhase step 8a), not before (files lost in host /mnt).
